name: Hidden Edge: Credential Capture
description: An inferred attack path reviewed by the operator, not a declared flow: an attacker positioned at the source captures a credential carried by a flow and uses it at the flow's responder (ATT&CK T1040, T1557): a path the model does not declare as a flow. Dethereal writes a flow of this class when the operator accepts a hidden-edge candidate; it is never the class of an ordinary data flow.
